info.title: API.SH: JobStreet
info.description: The JobStreet API from API.SH: public JobStreet data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company's profile on JobStreet (Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia) or JobsDB (Hong Kong, Thailand): name, link, claimed flag, industry, size, website, headquarters, specialities, overview, why join us, mission, culture and values, awards, perks and benefits, logo, cover and gallery images, rating, the first reviews (title, job title, location, pros, cons, employment, salary summary, recommended, ratings by area) with the review count, and similar companies.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jobstreet-company

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The last part of the company page link, e.g. `petronas-lubricants-168559177895523`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A company page link (e.g. https://my.jobstreet.com/companies/...), instead of `slug`; it also sets the country.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site: my, sg, ph, id (JobStreet) or hk, th (JobsDB). Default my.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every live job of one advertiser on JobStreet (Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia) or JobsDB (Hong Kong, Thailand), with the same fields and filters as search (keywords, location, sort, listing date, work type, work arrangement, classification, salary range). Use `advertiser.id` from search or job results. `total` is the advertiser's live job count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. An advertiser with no live jobs answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jobstreet-company-jobs

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: The advertiser's id (`advertiser.id` of a job), e.g. `60388665`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job ad on JobStreet or JobsDB by id or link: title, company and advertiser (verified flag), location, work type, classification, salary and currency, listing and expiry dates, abstract, full description (HTML and text), bullet points, screening questions, video, logo, and the company profile (overview, industry, size, website, rating and review count).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jobstreet-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id (e.g. 95308618) or a job link.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A JobStreet / JobsDB job link (its domain sets the country), instead of `id`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site for `id`: my (default), sg, ph, id, hk, th.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobstreet / Jobsdb's salary guide for a role in one country (monthly pay in the local currency): typical range and median, the suggested range, pay by state or region (with a link to that area's jobs), the role's description, classification, key skills, review count and similar roles, and up to 10 current jobs for the role with their advertised pay.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jobstreet-salary

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Role slug as in jobstreet.com/career-advice/role/<role>/salary (e.g. software-engineer, accountant, nurse), or the page link in `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A career-advice salary link (its country site is used).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on JobStreet (Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia) and JobsDB (Hong Kong, Thailand) for keywords and/or location, with the sites' filters: sort, listing date, work type, work arrangement, classification and monthly salary range. Each job: id, title, link, company and advertiser, location(s), classification, work types and arrangements, salary, teaser, bullet points, listing date, featured flag and logo. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jobstreet-search

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: my (default), sg, ph, id (JobStreet), hk, th (JobsDB).

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: Only this advertiser's jobs: `advertiser.id` of a job in the results, e.g. `60388665`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
